description: Slide and merge the tiles to reach the elusive 2048.
controls: Use the arrow keys or swipe to slide the tiles. Matching numbers merge into one — plan ahead so the board never fills up.

title: Aim Trainer Pro
description: Sharpen your reflexes and clicking accuracy.
controls: Move the mouse to aim and click the targets as fast as you can before the timer runs out.

title: Air Shot
description: Aim, shoot, and pop your way to a high score.
controls: Aim with the mouse, then click or hold to shoot. Pop as many targets as possible before you run out of shots.

title: Breakout
description: Smash every brick with a ball and paddle.
controls: Move the paddle with the arrow keys or your mouse. Keep the ball in play and clear every brick.

title: Bubble Shooter
description: Aim and match three bubbles to clear the board.
controls: Aim with the mouse and click to fire. Connect three or more bubbles of the same color to pop them.

title: Carrom
description: Flick the striker and pocket every disc.
controls: Drag the striker to position it, pull back to set power, and release to shoot. Pocket your discs before your opponent.

title: Chess
description: Outsmart a sharp AI in the timeless game of strategy.
controls: Click or tap a piece to select it, then click a highlighted square to move. Checkmate the enemy king to win.

title: Connect Four
description: Drop your discs and line up four in a row.
controls: Click or tap a column to drop your disc. Line up four in a row — across, down, or diagonally — before the AI does.

title: Cricket
description: Time your shots, bowl them out, and chase the total.
controls: Click, tap, or press Space to swing exactly when the ball arrives. Perfect timing sends it to the boundary.

title: Dots and Boxes
description: Close the boxes and claim the bigger share.
controls: Click or tap an edge between two dots to draw a line. Complete the fourth side of a box to claim it and move again.

title: Flappy Bird
description: One tap keeps you flying through the pipes.
controls: Click, tap, or press Space to flap. Slip through the gaps between the pipes and keep your streak alive.

title: Hangman
description: Guess the hidden word before the tries run out.
controls: Type letters on your keyboard or tap the on-screen letters to guess the hidden word one letter at a time.

title: Helix Jump
description: Bounce the ball down the spiral without hitting red.
controls: Drag left and right or use the arrow keys to rotate the tower. Guide the ball through the gaps and avoid the red zones.

title: Knife Hit
description: Throw knives and stick them into the spinning log.
controls: Click, tap, or press Space to throw a knife into the spinning log. Never hit another knife.

title: Ludo
description: Race all four tokens home in this dice classic.
controls: Tap the dice to roll, then tap a highlighted token to move it. Get all four tokens home before your rivals.

title: Memory Match
description: Flip the cards and find every matching pair.
controls: Click or tap cards to flip them over. Remember what you saw and find every matching pair in as few moves as you can.

title: Minesweeper
description: Clear the grid without stepping on a mine.
controls: Left-click to reveal a cell and right-click to plant a flag. The numbers tell you how many mines touch that square.

title: Neon Racer
description: Weave through traffic on a glowing high-speed track.
controls: Steer with the arrow keys or A and D. Dodge traffic, grab boosts, and chase your top speed.

title: Crossword
description: Test your vocabulary and cognitive word-association skills.
controls: Tap a cell and type letters to fill the grid. Switch between Across and Down clues and complete every word to win.

title: Find 10
description: Pair numbers that add up to exactly 10 before time runs out.
controls: Select any two numbers on the board that add up to exactly 10 to clear them. Keep pairing to build your score before the timer ends.

title: Arrows Out
description: Escape the impossible neon maze before time runs out.
controls: Move with the arrow keys or the on-screen controls. Race through the neon maze and reach the exit before the 120-second timer hits zero.

title: Escape Puzzle
description: Solve clues, unlock mysteries and escape the room.
controls: Tap objects in the room to inspect them and collect clues. Use the hints you find to crack the keypad code and unlock the door.

title: Level Devil
description: A trick-filled cartoon platformer where the level trolls you at every step — nothing stays where you left it.
controls: Move with arrow keys or A/D, jump with Space/Up/W. Reach the door without getting caught by disappearing platforms, hidden spikes and reversed controls.

title: Who Is?
description: Investigate quirky mysteries, pin down clues around the scene, and accuse the right suspect before you run out of lives.
controls: Click glowing clue pins to reveal evidence, then click a suspect card to make your accusation.

title: Number Guess
description: Classic higher-or-lower number guessing with three difficulty levels and a live narrowing range meter.
controls: Type a number and press Guess. Use the Higher/Lower feedback to narrow down the secret number before you run out of guesses.
